The first map is of the first age of Arda, after the lamps of middle earth had been broken and scorched the landscape. This was the world that elves and men were both born into.

The second map is a close up of Beleriand, the region that the first age elves fought Morgoth for the silmarils, and the region where the majority of the Silmarillion takes place.

The third map is a world map of the second age of Arda, after Morgoth had been defeated by the Valar and sent into the void. Note the appearance of the isle of Numinor, the region where Earendil's kin were brought after the defeat of Morgoth as a reward for their loyalty to the Valar and their aid in defeating Morgoth.

The fourth map shows the far eastern regions of Arda, of which little is known.

The fifth map shows Arda directly after the sinking of Numinor and the curving of the world, these events take place in second age 3319. This map is also represents Arda as it would be in all of the lotr books.

The sixth map is a close up of Middle Earth, a map I hope many of you are familiar with.
